_doc: Lagu unit (SP 7.1.1-7.1.6). Suku kata ikut lagu asal: 'X oh X' (5) + 'kenapa ...' (7) / 'Macam mana aku ...' (9) + jawapan (6-7). Gaya: --style=tadika|joget (tools/songs/make_song.py STYLES). Sebutan baku.
title: Paku Oh Paku
caption: slow gentle Malaysian children's song, {style}, sung in standard Malaysian Malay (sebutan baku), clear Malaysian diction, not Indonesian, {voice}, easy for 7-year-olds to sing along, warm and cheerful, major key

voices.female: warm clear female voice, Malaysian kindergarten teacher
voices.male: friendly clear male voice, Malaysian primary school teacher

lyrics:
[Verse 1]
Paku oh paku, kenapa kau melekat?
Macam mana aku tak lekat, magnet menarik besi

[Verse 2]
Pensel oh pensel, kenapa kau tak lekat?
Macam mana aku nak lekat, aku bukannya besi

[Verse 3]
Magnet oh magnet, kenapa kau menolak?
Macam mana aku tak tolak, kutub kita sama

[Verse 4]
Magnet oh magnet, kenapa kau menarik?
Macam mana aku tak tarik, kutub kita berlainan

[Verse 5]
Peti oh peti, kenapa pintu rapat?
Macam mana aku tak rapat, ada magnet di situ
